column3: Mercury is lit.\nI failed to guard it.\nWhy should I trust you?{end_wait}
Jenna and Kraden\nare with Menardi.\nHelp us reach them.{end_wait}
I swore to protect\nthis lighthouse.\nI was too late.{end_wait}
Then come with us.\nWe may still save them.{end_wait}
You're right.\nWe have no time to argue.{page_break}I'll follow Menardi.\nYou stop Saturos.{end_wait}
Go, healer.\nThe beacon is already lit.{end_wait}
I was wrong about you,\nIsaac. I'm sorry.{end_wait}
Menardi has Jenna.\nI must follow before\nthey get away.{end_wait}
I know. I'll bring\nher back if I can.\nPlease trust me.{end_wait}
I'll be careful.\nShe has the hostages.\nI won't forget that.{end_wait}
Your healer is gone.\nNow face me.{end_wait}
